cardInfo.summary: The buyer's Procure-to-Pay console: requisitions, RFQs, POs, receipts, and budget health in one tabbed shell.

attributes.readMe:
## RFQ-to-Payment App (Rt)

The Procure-to-Pay console composing the procurement blocks unchanged: a six-station flow rail (Onboarding → Requisitions → RFQs → Approvals → Receiving → Match & Pay) whose stations click through to pre-filtered lists; per-tab collection shells (search + status badges + grid/list/table views); the Vendors tab mounts the shared StatusBoard; the Invoices tab lists AP-leg vendor invoices whose isolated view carries the Three-Way Match Panel; budgets render through ProcurementBudget's dual-segment commitment bar. Every status transition stays on its owning command — no drag-to-approve anywhere.

### Example

The linked instance runs the full chain against the realm's example world, ending at INV N-4471 mid-match.

### Non-goals

No payment execution (Approve for Payment hands over to the existing Payment flow). No vendor persona.
